OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: Follows the input after the delay
1 while a switching time is active
1 while a calendar entry is active

PULSE_GENERATOR.NAME: Pulse generator
PULSE_GENERATOR.DESCRIPTION: While enabled the output alternates between 1 for the on time and 0 for the off time

ON.NAME: On time [s]
ON.DESCRIPTION: Duration of the 1 phase, at least 0.1 s

OFF.NAME: Off time [s]
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Duration of the 0 phase, at least 0.1 s

CLICK_DETECTION.NAME: Click detection
CLICK_DETECTION.DESCRIPTION: Tells single, double and triple clicks and a long press of a push button apart. The button must send 1 on press and 0 on release

SINGLE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse after a single click (one click window late)

LONG.DESCRIPTION: 1 from the long press time until the button is released

CLICK_WINDOW.NAME: Click window [ms]
CLICK_WINDOW.DESCRIPTION: Maximum time between two clicks of a double or triple click

LONG_PRESS.NAME: Long press [ms]
LONG_PRESS.DESCRIPTION: Hold time for a long press, 0 = off (for buttons that send no release)

OFF.DESCRIPTION: 1 resets the output and locks the block until Off is 0 again

ON_OFF_DELAY.NAME: Switch-on and -off delay
ON_OFF_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: The output follows the input, switching on after the on delay and off after the off delay

ON.NAME: On delay [s]
ON.DESCRIPTION: Time the input must be 1 before the output switches on

OFF.NAME: Off delay [s]
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Time the input must be 0 before the output switches off

SAVING_ON_DELAY.NAME: Saving switch-on delay
SAVING_ON_DELAY.DESCRIPTION: A pulse at the input switches the output on after the delay; it stays on until Off

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: 1 from the end of the delay until Off

DELAY.NAME: Delay [s]
DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Time from the pulse until the output switches on

EDGE_WIPING_RELAY.NAME: Edge-triggered wiping relay
EDGE_WIPING_RELAY.DESCRIPTION: Every pulse at the input sends a fixed number of pulses at the output

ON.NAME: On time [s]
ON.DESCRIPTION: Length of each pulse, at least 0.1 s

OFF.NAME: Off time [s]
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Pause between two pulses, at least 0.1 s

CYCLES.NAME: Cycles
CYCLES.DESCRIPTION: Number of pulses per input pulse

DELAYED_PULSE.NAME: Delayed pulse
DELAYED_PULSE.DESCRIPTION: A pulse at the input sends a pulse at the output after the delay

TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Pulse starts the delay, another pulse during the delay restarts it

DELAY.NAME: Delay [s]
DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Time from the input pulse to the output pulse

PULSE.NAME: Pulse length [s]
PULSE.DESCRIPTION: Length of the output pulse, at least 0.1 s

PWM.NAME: Pulse width modulation
PWM.DESCRIPTION: Turns an analog value 0..10 into an on/off signal with that duty cycle

VALUE.DESCRIPTION: Duty cycle 0..10 (0 = always off, 10 = always on)

PERIOD.NAME: Period [s]
PERIOD.DESCRIPTION: Length of one on/off cycle, at least 0.1 s

RAMP.NAME: Ramp controller
RAMP.DESCRIPTION: Moves the output step by step every 100 ms towards one of two levels

STOP.DESCRIPTION: 1 sets the output to the start value and holds it

START.NAME: Start value
START.DESCRIPTION: Value at the start and while Stop is 1

STEP.NAME: Step size
STEP.DESCRIPTION: Change per 100 ms, 0 = jump to the level
